subject: Request: HSM attestation + sanity rotation samples for SIG/CAIQ mapping
messages:
From: Sam Hale <sam.hale@kelvinsec.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@greenline.io>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HSM attestation + rotation samples we need for SIG/CAIQ

Marissa —

Thanks for taking this. We're working through Kelvin's SIG and CAIQ review and have a short list of artifacts we need to validate your key management posture. Can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday if possible?

1) Any HSM vendor attestation or tamper-evident seal statement you can share (PDF) — redacted for customer-specific info is fine.
2) A small set (2–3 rows) of redacted rotation logs showing a typical KEK and DEK rollover event (timestamps, rotation actor id, rotation reason). Deeply sensitive fields can be masked — we just need format and cadence.
3) A brief summary of in-transit encryption (TLS versions, cipher suites, mutual TLS usage for internal RPCs) — a one-page txt is fine.
4) Confirmation of rotation windows / policy (how often KEK rotated, DEK ephemeral lifetime), and whether emergency rotation drills exist.

If you need us to sign an NDA or a special disclosure, let me know. Olivia and I will compile into the SIG spreadsheet.

Appreciate it —
Sam
Security Assurance, Kelvin Security

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Hale <sam.hale@kelvinsec.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HSM attestation + rotation samples we need for SIG/CAIQ

Sam — thanks for the clear list. We're able to provide the items you requested but need to redact operational identifiers from the rotation logs. High-level plan:

• Attached: redwood_hsm_attestation_20280310.pdf — vendor-signed statement (HSM vendor redaction applied).
• Attached: rotation_log_samples_redacted_20280310.csv — two anonymized events: one KEK rollover, one DEK refresh. Timestamps and actor role are preserved; tenant identifiers masked.
• Attached: transit_cipher_matrix_2028.txt — summarizes TLS for public API and internal RPC, cipher suites, and mutual-TLS usage.
• Rotation policy summary: KEK rotation cadence: annually (or upon vendor advisory). DEK (data encryption keys): rolling per-tenant or bucket; default TTL 30 days for ephemeral DEKs, can be configured per-customer. Emergency rotation procedure exists and we've done tabletop drills quarterly — we can provide an excerpt of the runbook on request.

Irene and Jonas are looped for any additional logs or verification you need. If the drive link works for you, we'll upload a sanitized bundle; otherwise I can push these PDFs directly to your SFTP.

Next steps:
- Please confirm whether the redactions are acceptable for your SIG scoring.
- If you need raw rotation logs under an NDA, tell us the required scope.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_hsm_attestation_20280310.pdf; rotation_log_samples_redacted_20280310.csv; transit_cipher_matrix_2028.txt
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: HSM attestation + rotation samples we need for SIG/CAIQ

Irene / Jonas —

Pasting Sam's asks below. I've attached the sanitized artifacts we're willing to share. Quick asks: can you both confirm the rotation log redaction is sufficient (we kept actor role and timestamp but masked tenant IDs and key material)? Also, Jonas, can you confirm the KEK rotation trigger language (vendor advisory vs. automatic annual) for the runbook excerpt?

We want to avoid exposing internal IAM principals while giving the auditor enough context. If you need to tighten the masking, say so and I'll re-send.

On the drive: I uploaded a ZIP to the shared folder (link in the metadata). If Kelvin needs raw logs under an NDA, we should coordinate a scoped export (limit to the three events and obfuscate request IDs).

Thanks —
M

From: Sam Hale <sam.hale@kelvinsec.com>

Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HSM attestation + rotation samples we need for SIG/CAIQ

Marissa —

Received the bundle, thanks. The attestation PDF looks good after vendor redaction. The sample rotation CSV format is exactly what our auditor needs; the masked fields are acceptable. A couple of small follow-ups:

• For the KEK rotation trigger, could you confirm whether you consider "vendor advisory" sufficient for an annual scheduled rotation, or if there is an automated cross-check in your orchestration layer? A one-sentence clarification is fine.
• For the emergency rotation drill: can you share the date of the most recent tabletop and whether a post-drill incident review was recorded? No PII, just date and whether findings were closed.

If you can drop those two points into a quick reply, we'll mark the SIG item as satisfied. Olivia and I will also request the CAIQ mapping row for the key management questions.

Thanks again —
Sam
Security Assurance, Kelvin Security

Attachments: none
